sections.title: Nature and Purpose of the Group

items.text: Éxito Juntos is not a company, organization, association, society, or legal entity, whether for-profit or non-profit.

It is a network of independent friends and contacts who participate freely, voluntarily, and autonomously with the sole objective of maintaining communication and updated information about opportunities or invitations extended by external companies (hereinafter, "the Inviting Company").
The purpose of the group is informative and organizational, limited to the exchange of news, updates, and experiences about such invitations.
Éxito Juntos does not carry out, promote, or facilitate any financial, stock market, commercial, mercantile, or money collection activities, either directly or indirectly.

sections.title: Declaration of Autonomy and Individual Responsibility

items.text: Each member of Éxito Juntos acts under their exclusive individual responsibility towards the inviting companies or any third party.
Membership in the group does not generate contractual, commercial, corporate, or representation relationships between its members.
No member may attribute to Éxito Juntos any responsibility for decisions, losses, or actions taken personally before an external company.
Each member fully acknowledges the inherent risks of any individual participation in third-party activities, assuming full responsibility for their actions and decisions.
It is strictly prohibited to:
subitems: Use terminology related to "investments," "profits," "returns," "capital," "financial participation," or similar.
Request, receive, or transfer values, commissions, or economic amounts within or on behalf of the group.
Promote commercial, financial, or intermediation activities.
Use the brand, name, or structure of Éxito Juntos for economic, political, or religious purposes.

items.text: The group does not manage funds, does not act as a financial intermediary, nor does it maintain collective or representative bank accounts.

sections.title: Legal Framework and Freedom of Association

items.text: This group is protected by the fundamental right to freedom of association and expression, recognized by:
subitems: First Amendment of the United States Constitution, which guarantees the right to freely associate for lawful purposes.
Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union (Art. 12), which recognizes the right of everyone to freedom of peaceful assembly and association at all levels.
American Convention on Human Rights (Art. 16), which protects the right to free association in Latin America.

items.text: Therefore, Éxito Juntos constitutes a lawful group, protected by international civil rights laws, as it does not pursue any unlawful or profit-making purpose.
Éxito Juntos respects and protects the personal data of its members in accordance with:
subitems: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR – EU 2016/679), applicable to residents of the European Union.
California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and U.S. federal legislation.

Personal Data Protection Laws in Latin America, such as Law No. 19,628 (Chile), Law 1581/2012 (Colombia), Law 25,326 (Argentina), Law 29733 (Peru), and Federal Law on Personal Data Protection (Mexico).

items.text: The data collected (name, contact, country of residence, and other registration information) will be used solely for internal informational purposes and group organization.
Data will not be shared with third parties nor used for commercial purposes.
Every member has the right to request at any time the complete deletion of their personal data and their disassociation from the group.
Acceptance of these terms is an essential condition to be part of the Éxito Juntos group.
Upon joining, the member declares:
subitems: Having read, understood, and fully accepted this document.
Recognizing that the group does not offer financial advice or promises of profitability.
Assuming complete independence regarding any personal decision derived from information shared in the group.

items.text: Éxito Juntos and its administrators will not be responsible, under any circumstances, for:
subitems: Economic losses, damages, or harm arising from personal actions of the members.
Contents, decisions, or links of the Inviting Company or third parties.
Any misinterpretation of information shared in the group.

items.text: Each member expressly releases the group and other members from any civil, commercial, or legal liability arising from personal or third-party activities.
Members must maintain respectful, transparent, and collaborative behavior.
All forms of the following are prohibited:
subitems: Dissemination of false or misleading information.
Promotion of financial schemes, investment networks, or unverified businesses.
Discrimination, harassment, or offensive language.

items.text: Any breach may result in immediate and permanent exclusion from the group.
In case of controversy, members agree to resolve disagreements through friendly dialogue and private conciliation, without involving the group as an entity.
This document will be interpreted under the principles of Private International Law, recognizing the multinational and non-institutional character of the group.
There will be no single jurisdiction, given that members come from different countries, and each will be responsible according to the laws of their respective territory.
This document may be updated periodically with the unanimous approval of active members.
New versions must be expressly accepted by members to maintain their membership.
By accepting this document, each participant freely and voluntarily declares:
subitems: Their agreement with all the conditions established herein.
Their knowledge that Éxito Juntos is an informative group without corporate structure.
Their commitment to act in accordance with ethics, law, and mutual respect.
